page.overview:
Who is Easy Idle Pitty?

The Easy Idle Pitty is a Nemomatic forklift appearing in Cars and Cars 3.

He probably doesn't make his physical appearence in the first film. He was preparing Ruby Oaks with his pit crew.

Like the first film he was reparing Carl Clutchen in some Piston Cup races.
